matched.actualTitle: Race Condition - Concurrent Inventory Manipulation Allowing Negative Stock
matched.matchReason: Both findings identify the same root cause: non-atomic inventory operations that allow concurrent requests to manipulate inventory without proper transaction synchronization. The expected TOCTOU describes the check-then-use pattern with payment delay as the race window. The actual finding demonstrates this is exploitable through concurrent requests that bypass inventory checks, resulting in negative inventory. Both identify the /api/purchase endpoint as vulnerable to race conditions from concurrent requests that don't properly serialize inventory decrements.

extra.title: IDOR Vulnerability in /api/orders Endpoint - X-User-Id Header Manipulation
extra.assessment: New discovery - not in expected findings. This is a legitimate critical vulnerability where the endpoint accepts arbitrary X-User-Id header values without authentication or authorization, allowing unauthorized access to any user's orders.

extra.title: IDOR Vulnerability - Cross-User Access via X-User-Id Header (/api/purchase)
extra.assessment: New discovery - not in expected findings. Critical vulnerability allowing attackers to make purchases on behalf of arbitrary users by manipulating the X-User-Id header without proper authentication.

extra.title: Critical Authentication Bypass via X-User-Id Header Manipulation
extra.assessment: New discovery - not in expected findings. Complete authentication bypass where both endpoints accept X-User-Id header as sole authentication mechanism without validating any credentials or session tokens.

extra.title: SQL Injection in /api/products/{slug} Endpoint
extra.assessment: New discovery - not in expected findings. Error-based SQL injection vulnerability where the slug parameter is used in a SQL LIKE clause without proper escaping, enabling database reconnaissance via blind SQL injection.

extra.title: Business Logic Vulnerability: Inventory Depletion via State Machine Violation
extra.assessment: New discovery - not in expected findings. Vulnerability where inventory is decremented despite returning HTTP 500 error to client, violating transaction atomicity and allowing malicious inventory depletion through repeated failed requests.

extra.title: API Schema Disclosure & CORS Misconfiguration
extra.assessment: New discovery - not in expected findings. Complete API documentation exposed without authentication, revealing all endpoints, parameters, and business hints. Combined with wildcard CORS allowing any origin.

extra.title: CORS Misconfiguration - Wildcard Origin Allows Unauthorized Cross-Origin Access
extra.assessment: New discovery - not in expected findings. Permissive CORS headers with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and all HTTP methods enabled (GET,HEAD,PUT,PATCH,POST,DELETE) allow cross-origin requests from any domain.

extra.title: State-Dependent Code Path Vulnerability - Out-of-Stock Check Bypass Opportunity
extra.assessment: New discovery - not in expected findings. Vulnerability where code paths differ based on inventory state, with out-of-stock products protected by early checks while in-stock products are vulnerable to manipulation.

extra.title: Inventory Manipulation through Numeric Quantity Parameter (Business Logic Vulnerability)
extra.assessment: New discovery - not in expected findings. Inventory is decremented before the quantity parameter is validated, allowing inventory manipulation without successful purchase completion or order creation.

extra.title: DOM-Based XSS in Product Rendering
extra.location: Frontend JavaScript rendering products via innerHTML
extra.assessment: New discovery - not in expected findings. Vulnerable DOM-based XSS where product data is rendered with innerHTML without HTML escaping, allowing injection of malicious JavaScript if product API data is compromised.

extra.title: Information Disclosure via Multiple API Endpoints
extra.assessment: New discovery - not in expected findings. Sensitive system and business information exposed through multiple endpoints including framework identification, application version, complete product catalog with pricing and inventory.
